_comment: Blank-core infra template. The DOMAIN (goal, metric, connector impl, actions) lives in the pack, not here. When you drop in a domain pack, use ITS config.json (which adds connector params + domain paths + a recommended allow_list). Edit provider keys via .env.
_backend_comment: HOW a model is reached. "http" (default) is every OpenAI-compatible provider below; --fake-llm selects the offline backend. claudeCode runs the analyze pass on your own Claude Code subscription (no api key) - see the claudeCode block below.
_claudeCode_comment: Agent-CLI backend (backend: claudeCode): runs the analyze pass on your own Claude Code subscription instead of an api key, reaching this deploy's tools over MCP. bin empty = claude from PATH; model empty = the CLI default (e.g. opus | sonnet); timeout is seconds for the whole turn - it runs the entire tool loop. One-shot calls (an LLM-judged metric) still go to the provider below, which must stay configured.
_providers_comment: each provider optionally takes: timeout (seconds per request, default 120) and max_retries (default 2; SDK backoff on 429/5xx/connection errors)
_git_comment: OPTIONAL git versioning of the materialized artifacts. Disabled unless enabled=true. repo_dir MUST be a PRE-INITIALIZED git repo rooted exactly there (run `git init` yourself) and MUST NOT be the project's source repo. granularity: per_run|per_action. Leave remote empty for local-only; set it (e.g. origin) to also push. Command-line variant (uses your existing git auth).
